import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import load_config, read_dotenv

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

    handle, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".env")
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return path


def run_doctor(cwd, extra_env=None):
    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": ROOT}
    env.update(extra_env or {})
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"],
        cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
    )


class DotenvParsingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_double_quoted_with_escapes(self):
        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="a\\"b\\\\c"\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], 'a"b\\c')

    def test_single_quoted_is_literal(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN='a\\nb'\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], "a\\nb")

    def test_export_with_extra_whitespace(self):
        path = write_env("export   PAYHOOK_REGION = us\n")
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "us")

    def test_inline_comment_after_unquoted_value(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=15   # seconds\nPAYHOOK_REGION=eu#notcomment\n")
        values = read_dotenv(path)
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], "15")
        self.assertEqual(values["PAYHOOK_REGION"], "eu#notcomment")

        path = write_env('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="a # b"\n')
        self.assertEqual(read_dotenv(path)["PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN"], "a # b")

    def test_unterminated_quote_reports_line(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_REGION=eu\nPAYHOOK_API_TOKEN=\"abc\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, r":2: unterminated"):
            read_dotenv(path)

    def test_line_without_equals_reports_line(self):
        path = write_env("PAYHOOK_REGION\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, r":1: expected KEY=value"):
            read_dotenv(path)

    def test_repo_env_file_loads(self):
        env_path = os.path.join(ROOT, ".env")
        if not os.path.exists(env_path):
            self.skipTest("no .env in repo")
        config = load_config(environ={}, dotenv_path=env_path)
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT"][0], "https://api.payments.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live")
        self.assertEqual(config["PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT"], ("15", ".env"))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reports_source_and_masks_secrets(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, ".env"), "w") as f:
                f.write('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sk_test_SECRETVALUE123"\nexport PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=20\n')
            result = run_doctor(tmp, {"PAYHOOK_REGION": "us"})
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        out = result.stdout
        self.assertNotIn("SECRETVALUE123", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN = (set, 22 characters, redacted)  [source: .env]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET = (not set)  [source: default]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = '20'  [source: .env]", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = 'us'  [source: environment]", out)
        self.assertIn("(not found)", out)

    def test_repo_env_secrets_are_not_printed(self):
        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(ROOT, ".env")):
            self.skipTest("no .env in repo")
        result = run_doctor(ROOT)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn("ABBCANARY", result.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.payments.example/v2?region=eu&mode=live'  [source: .env]", result.stdout)

    def test_malformed_env_reports_error(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, ".env"), "w") as f:
                f.write("PAYHOOK_REGION=\"eu\n")
            result = run_doctor(tmp)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("unterminated", result.stderr)

    unittest.main()
